extensionDescription.message: Give custom names to ZIP files downloaded in bulk from Google Drive.

defaultTemplateLabel.message: Default template (initial value in the download dialog)

promptOnDownload.message: Show the naming dialog when downloading a ZIP from Drive

promptOffNote.message: When off, files are renamed only when you reserve a name in the popup first.

conflictLabel.message: When a file with the same name exists

allowMultiple.message: Support split ZIPs (for 30 seconds after the first ZIP, use the same name + _part2, _part3…)

autoClear.message: Clear the reservation after use (when split ZIP support is off)

presetsNote.message: Save frequently used naming templates and select them with one click in the popup or download dialog.

backupDescription.message: Export and import settings and presets as a JSON file. You can use it to share naming rules with your team.

invalidJson.message: The file could not be read as JSON.

invalidSettingsFormat.message: The settings file format is invalid.

wrongSettingsFile.message: This is not a settings file for this extension.

tooManyPresets.message: You can save up to $LIMIT$ presets.

defaultTemplateTooLong.message: The default template is too long.

saveFolderTooLong.message: The destination subfolder name is too long.

unmatchedBrace.message: A template variable has an unmatched brace.

historyItemTitle.message: Click to use in the input field

expansionFailed.message: The template could not be resolved and the naming dialog is disabled, so the original name was used.

driveTabNotFound.message: The Drive tab could not be identified safely, so the original name was used.

renameFailed.message: An error occurred while changing the filename.

presetRequired.message: Enter a preset name and template.

dialogContextDefault.message: Choose a filename for the ZIP downloaded from Google Drive

unresolvedVariables.message: Values are unavailable for these variables: $VARIABLES$

countdown.message: The original filename will be used in $SECONDS$ seconds.
